Metadata.title: Keyboard Designer
Metadata.description: Design custom keycaps in the browser, free and what-you-see-is-what-you-get. No sign-up, no fees.

hero.subtitle: A free keyboard editor with live preview. No sign-up — open it and start designing.

features.wysiwygBody: An intuitive keyboard editor with live preview of every keycap’s color, legend, and icon. Drag to arrange and see results instantly.
features.colorBody: Custom colors and gradients, covering the palettes mechanical keyboards actually use.
features.exportBody: Export SVG vectors or high-res PNG in one click, ready to share or print.
features.layoutBody: Recognizes 60%, 75%, TKL and other common layouts, with one-click key alignment.

testimonials.title: Built for custom-keyboard fans
testimonials.subtitle: From color ideas and layout fitting to file export — design a full keycap set in the browser, for free.

0.quote: Keyboard Designer completely changed my workflow. I used to paint keycaps one by one in Photoshop; now I drag, recolor, and preview live. A full palette in ten minutes.
0.name: Ming Zhang

1.quote: The UI is intuitive and easy to pick up. You can make pro-looking palettes without learning complex software.
1.name: Ya Li

2.quote: Finally a tool made for keyboard design. Switching layouts is so convenient.
2.name: Hao Wang

3.quote: From idea to finished set in one afternoon. Love the palettes and export quality — highly recommend.
3.name: Si Chen

0.a: This site is completely free. No sign-up required — every feature is available immediately.

1.a: 60%, 75%, TKL and other common mechanical layouts. The editor aligns keys automatically, and you can switch layouts anytime.

2.a: SVG vectors and high-res PNG, for sharing mockups or print previews.

3.a: Designs live in the current browser session. Refreshing or closing the tab discards unsaved work — export JSON as a backup. No sign-up, no fees.

4.q: Can exports be used for production?
4.a: Yes. Exported SVG includes keycap colors and legends, and can be used as a production reference.

cta.title: Start designing your keycaps
cta.body: Fully open source, no sign-up. Open the editor, pick a layout, dial in your palette, and finish in minutes.

footer.blurb: Design keycaps in the browser, what-you-see-is-what-you-get. Fully open source, no sign-up.
